explication: Lap is a local-first desktop photo manager: users connect existing folders as libraries, index and organize their media, then browse, search, edit, and manage files without uploading them. The graph follows the visible Tauri/Vue entry points and the product capabilities documented in the README. The supplied excerpts do not show the implementation of the command handlers or most domain modules, so their internal call wiring is intentionally left unspecified.
